# Grove Hub — Chennai Growth Studio & Digital Marketing Partner
> Chennai's premier on-location commercial content studio and in-store customer acquisition partner.

## Overview
Grove Hub (https://groovehubstudio.in) engineers in-store sales growth and direct footfall for local physical businesses across Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. Grove Hub combines three synchronized growth pillars:
1. **Local SEO & Google Maps 3-Pack Optimization**: Dominating local Chennai search queries to capture customers actively searching for services nearby.
2. **On-Location Commercial Video Production**: Authentic on-site shoots executed with high-end mobile phone rigs, pro studio lighting, motorized gimbals, and wireless audio. Producing high-retention commercial Reels that create urgent local desire.
3. **Automated WhatsApp CRM & In-Store Sales Loops**: Converting inquiries and profile visits into confirmed walk-in appointments and paying customers at the cash counter.

## Core Packages & Pricing
- **Basic Monthly Retainer**: Exactly 6 Commercial Reels + 3 Branded Posts (On-location shoots + full post-production editing). Zero account maintenance required. Tied to footfall, WhatsApp inquiries, and Google 3-Pack rank.
- **Zero-Risk Trial**: Free First On-Location Commercial Shoot (35-45 minutes) and 1 free finished commercial reel with zero contract or upfront payment.
